key_insight: ROAM-Bench evaluates not just whether an embodied AI reaches the right outcome, but whether it gathers evidence and fulfills the task requirements along the way. It checks these abilities under robot motion and collision constraints.
problem_solved: Existing benchmarks do not sufficiently distinguish correct final outcomes from completion of the exploration, interaction, and spatial reasoning requirements needed to achieve them.
method: Evaluate embodied agents on tasks requiring exploration, interaction, spatial reasoning, and action under motion and collision constraints.
Use simulation state and episode records to independently verify final outcomes and task requirements.
Apply stronger checks of geometry, coverage, or placement where relevant.
impact: ROAM-Bench offers practitioners a more rigorous way to assess embodied spatial intelligence beyond final-answer accuracy. Its evidence-based checks can help identify gaps between apparent success and verified task completion.
visual_elements: Side-by-side comparison: correct final outcome versus verified completion of task requirements.
Workflow diagram: explore → interact → gather evidence → reason and act → verify.
Simulated room map showing a robot trajectory, obstacles, and explored coverage.
Verification checklist separating outcome checks from geometry, coverage, and placement checks.
paper_title: ROAM-Bench: Evaluating Embodied Active Spatial Intelligence through Evidence Verification
paper_authors: Xingjian Ran, Xiaoye Mo, Sihao Liu, Li Luo, Taiqiang Wu
